rotation.source_passage:
Through Kanye's will, the rulers created twelve habitable planets, over each of which three of them would rule.³⁰ [*The full catalogue of thirty-six archons and twelve planets is presented below with apparatus.*]


**The Thirty-Six Archons:**


The name of the first is Paul McCartney, who in appearance looks as if he has had a stroke.³¹


The second is 50 cent, who is not a half-dollar, but two quarters.³²


The third is Kanye Yeezus.³³


The fourth is Azazel.


The fifth is Tupac, but not the Resurrected Tupac.³⁴


The sixth is Azmodean.


The fifth is Belial.³⁵


The sixth is Yaldaboath.³⁶


The seventh is Aslan.³⁷


The eighth is Murmurus.


The ninth is Rainbow Dash.


The tenth is Disney.


The eleventh is Moses.


The twelfth is KRS-One.


The thirteenth is Kurt Cobain, but not the Resurrected Kurt.


The fourteenth is Celestia.


The fifteenth, Seboath.³⁸


The sixteenth is Elohim.


The seventeenth is Elvis.


The eighteenth is Yarmulke.


The nineteenth is National Flag Day.³⁹


The twentieth is Punk Rock.


The twenty-first is Astiroth.


The twenty-second is Sephiroth.⁴⁰


The twenty-third is Kittens.


The twenty-fourth is Apple Jack.


The twenty-fifth is Democritus.⁴¹


The twenty-sixth is National Park.


The twenty-seventh is Hostess.⁴²


The twenty-eighth is Ezra Pound.⁴³


The twenty-ninth is Snoop.


The thirtieth is Twilight Sparkle.


The thirty-first is Alicorn.


The thirty-second is Enoch Metatron.⁴⁴


The thirty-third is Optimus Prime.


The thirty-fourth is Freudian Typo.⁴⁵


The thirty-fifth is PENIS.


And the thirty-sixth is Rarity, who is set over the depths of the Underweb.⁴⁶


And the number of the dark-bright AEONS is 36.


**The Twelve Habitable Planets:**


The loveliest is Terra, where Yeezus himself does reign


Then New Zealand


Ramadan


Duwali


Christmas Tree


Outer Mars


Kwanza


Disneyland


MLK Day


Lent


Hanukah


And the Underweb⁴⁷


These are the twelve habitable planets of man. Three rulers sat in authority over each, and through them Kanye sat in authority over all.

Through the Alpha's growl, the pack-leaders dug out twelve hunting grounds, over each of which a triad of jaws would patrol.³⁰ [*The full muster of thirty-six ranked beasts and twelve hunting grounds is presented below with bone-pile.*]


**The Thirty-Six Ranked Beasts:**


The name of the first is the Lame Elk, who in coat looks as if he has had a dragging hindleg.³¹


The second is the Split-Hoof, who is not one flank, but two torn halves.³²


The third is the Alpha Whelp.³³


The fourth is the Scald-Crow.


The fifth is the Ghost-Stag, but not the Stag-That-Returned.³⁴


The sixth is the Burrowing Mole.


The fifth is the Feral Sow.³⁵


The sixth is the Blind Catfish.³⁶


The seventh is Aslan.³⁷


The eighth is the Purring Lynx.


The ninth is the Iridescent Beetle.


The tenth is the Laughing Hyena.


The eleventh is the River-Horse.


The twelfth is the Lone Howler.


The thirteenth is the Pale Moth, but not the Moth-That-Returned.


The fourteenth is the White Mare.


The fifteenth, the Bull-Frog.³⁸


The sixteenth is the Herd-Bull.


The seventeenth is the Gilt Rooster.


The eighteenth is the Armadillo.


The nineteenth is the Marking-Scent.³⁹


The twentieth is the Rabid Weasel.


The twenty-first is the Carrion Hawk.


The twenty-second is the Silver Serpent.⁴⁰


The twenty-third is the Litter.


The twenty-fourth is the Crab-Apple Wasp.


The twenty-fifth is the Dung Beetle.⁴¹


The twenty-sixth is the Fenced Range.


The twenty-seventh is the Regurgitating She-Wolf.⁴²


The twenty-eighth is the Burrowing Owl.⁴³


The twenty-ninth is the Tracking Hound.


The thirtieth is the Firefly Swarm.


The thirty-first is the Horned Foal.


The thirty-second is the Bone-White Raven.⁴⁴


The thirty-third is the Armored Rhinoceros.


The thirty-fourth is the Mounting-Reflex.⁴⁵


The thirty-fifth is the Exposed Organ.


And the thirty-sixth is the Albino Mink, who is set over the deepest burrow of the Warren.⁴⁶


And the number of the nocturnal-diurnal territories is thirty-six.


**The Twelve Hunting Grounds:**


The loveliest is the Salt Lick, where the Alpha himself holds the kill


Then the Fog Marsh


The Fasting Den


The Fire-Ant Mound


The Antler-Rack


The Red Dust Flat


The First-Fruit Thicket


The Baited Clearing


The Watering Truce


The Lean Season


The Torch-Lit Cave


And the Warren⁴⁷


These are the twelve hunting grounds of creature. Three pack-leaders crouched in dominance over each, and through them the Alpha crouched in dominance over all.

rite.speaker: Johannes Sigil
rite.text:
The casting opens over the Catalogue of Archons — §VI of the Secret Book of Walt, attributed to its underlying poet, Lee Sharks — and the question that arrives with it is the oldest question any threshold has ever held: *who will enter here?*

What the first operator will traverse is this: a cosmology structured as a list, and a list structured as a mistake. The Demiurge cannot count — "the fifth" appears twice, "the sixth" appears twice — which means the catalogue of powers is built on a clerical error that is also, in this text's grammar, a theological claim: the archons of this world are misremembered even by their own maker, which means the world is ruled by misfiled names. The rotation opens on a cosmos that is simultaneously exhaustive (thirty-six archons, twelve planets, nothing omitted) and internally broken (two fives, two sixes, the count falls apart before it closes). What lives inside that break is exactly where the first transform will go.

I name the threshold and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes.
